phase_name: Permission Broker Production Consumption Implementation Plan
summary: Planning-only phase (no src/pcae/** modified, confirmed via git diff --name-only 169ff20a..HEAD -- src/pcae/, empty). Produced docs/PHASE_148D_PERMISSION_BROKER_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md: a bounded, line-level implementation plan for both real pcae push git-push dispatch sites (run_push() at push.py:454, _run_push_staged_file_aware() at push.py:604) to consume the Permission Broker per PBPC-001 v1.2 and PBPA-001 v1.0, both re-confirmed unamended (PBPC-001 still v1.2/FROZEN; PBPA-001 still v1.0, single commit 234fce06 since freeze; 148C-B-1 still CLOSED). Independently re-derived the current push control flow, both dispatch sites (matching PBPC-REQ-013 exactly), the HARD_BLOCK_REGISTRY (still 12 entries), and a direct dispatch-bypass search confirming no third git push invocation exists. Designed a single shared adapter helper (_evaluate_push_permission, placed in push.py, no new core module) invoked once immediately before each dispatch call; canonical request field-by-field provenance (action_type=push, execution_class=mutation, approval_present=False, simulation_only=True, each traced to PBPC-REQ-###); fail-closed decision consumption (ALLOW proceeds, DENY/HUMAN_REVIEW/broker-failure abort with zero dispatch); no caller-selectable policy set; no new CLI flags; a one-production-file change budget (src/pcae/commands/push.py, plus an optional bookkeeping-only touch to command_path_observation.py); a safe atomic-wiring commit strategy; and a full planned test inventory (ALLOW/DENY/HUMAN_REVIEW/broker-failure/non-bypassability/POL-004 and POL-005 regression/exactly-once/no-stale-decision-reuse) for a future tests/test_permission_broker_push_production_consumption.py, not implemented by this phase. This planning phase explicitly did NOT implement, wire, or activate Permission Broker production-consumption for pcae push -- that is 148E's deliverable. 148C-B-1 remains CLOSED; PBPC-001 remains v1.2; PBPA-001 remains v1.0, unamended; runtime remains Observed/observe/unavailable; Prompt Generation (Phase 45F) remains DEFERRED STRATEGIC OBSERVATION, untouched. Zero Blocking findings; zero Non-Blocking findings; one immaterial Observation (a pre-existing, already-finalized 148C.10 phase-report reconciliation-snapshot conflict, read-only, unrelated to 148D's own work). See docs/PHASE_148D_PERMISSION_BROKER_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md for full detail.
